Why did you choose Mutex over RwLock for the order queue?

Every successful `fetch` mutates the queue (move-to-back), so reads are effectively writes for the recency structure. An `RwLock` would degrade to write-locked on each access and pay extra atomic overhead for nothing. What false-positive rate should I expect for n=1M keys, m=10M bits, k=7?
